note: The dispatchable form of .agents/policies/failure.md. The Markdown is the explanation and this is what Noetic.Harness.Conductor reads; `mix harness.validate` asserts the two agree on the set of classes, because the alternative to duplication with a check is duplication without one. Patterns are anchored away from their own success strings: `\d+ failures?` matched the `0 failures` that `mix test` prints when everything passes, and since `test_failed` is first, any evidence quoting a passing run routed to regression analysis.

done.note: Next workflow step. Evidence is attached or the step is not done.

failed.note: Route by failure class. The retry budget decrements.

blocked.note: Emit the blocker as a bead with a discovered-from link, escalate to the named holder, stop. Do not work around it.

uncertain.note: Route to a verification role, or to the human if no evidence would settle it. Never promote.

needs_review.note: Route to a reviewer role that did not author the work.

classes.why: The test may be right. Read it before changing it.

classes.match: CompileError|undefined function|is not loaded|no function clause
classes.why: Guessing at an unfamiliar module is how contracts break.
Never fix generated TypeQL by pattern-matching the error. The TypeDB role loads the official skill first.
A performance role with a benchmark, not an opinion.
Two flakes in this repository were a stale build and a real race. Flaky is a hypothesis, not a diagnosis.

classes.observed: Benchmark gain with no holdout gain

classes.why: The workflow is the defect. Detected from the run ledger rather than from the text of a failure.
Report unavailable, continue what is still verifiable, name what is not. Never downgrade to a weaker check silently.
